review_notes: Independently reviewed the complete 210-line current proposal.json, 41-line functionality.md, 488-line fact-dispositions.json and 591-line link-dispositions.json. The current proposal differs from the librarian packet: it includes purpose corrections for aerial IASA and both physics callbacks. Those additional corrections are supported.

Read the entire 246-line owned source in canonical and rendered forms, all four subjects pages and all three outgoing-link pages. All 22 owned subjects, 51 baseline facts and 29 outgoing links are accounted for below.
All nine proposed writes target owned subjects. The proposal contains no new links, entities, merges or follow-ups. No replacement proposal or mutations are supplied by this review.
Verified actual Ca and Gn table consumers at ftKirby/ftkirby.c lines 1057-1078 and 2102-2123. All eight callbacks are shared. This finding does not depend on interpreting numeric enum labels.

Verified ftCommon_8007DB24 at ftcommon.c lines 650-655: it clears x2219_b0 and calls efLib_DestroyAll. The proposed destruction/reset description correctly replaces effect-update language. Unsupported hats still set the latch without spawning; the latch is not proof of allocation success.

Verified aerial IASA ordering and arithmetic grouping. A nonzero command is cleared before arithmetic; only x/y velocity is replaced. The proposal correctly distinguishes replacement from addition, per-command consumption from once-per-move behavior, and ordinary range behavior from invalid or exceptional floating-point inputs.

Verified the ground animation dispatcher at ft_08A1.c lines 53-109. Broad action-ending dispatch is supported, but unconditional Wait is not: there are early branches and downstream optional processing. Independently confirmed that ftCo_800C5240 checks for a held Hammer at ftCo_HammerWait.c lines 139-146.

Verified common ground/air conversion bodies, drift clamping, the literal ft_80081D0C return logic, and effect hitlag callback assignments. The functionality document correctly avoids equating the collision query return to stored ground_or_air and explicitly defers full collision and transition-flag semantics.

Verified the native ftCa_SpecialN_Enter reset-and-entry sequence at ftCaptain/ftcaptainspecialn.c lines 86-96. The retained ftKb_CaSpecialN_Enter name remains an inferred alias, not canonical spelling.

Acceptance preserves explicit uncertainties. In particular, the retained command-handoff fact and link are accepted only for the consumer-side pattern; animation-script producer identity and timing remain specifically deferred. References to both command variables mean the two observed slots 0 and 1, not an assertion that the entire array has two elements.

Landing/ground-loss language and complete animation/script preservation remain deferred; forwarding cur_anim_frame proves an argument only.

Effect allocation failure and subsystem ownership, external effect-latch resets, full Fighter_ChangeMotionState flag effects, and hitlag callback invocation/removal lifetime remain unresolved beyond direct calls and pointer assignments.

Detailed ftAnim_8006EBA4 and movement-helper behavior remains deferred. The independently read ground completion dispatcher supports its broad action-ending role but has optional branches and does not establish unconditional Wait.
